summary: Nano Nuclear Energy Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing that on September 28, 2026, it and subsidiary HALEU Energy Fuel Inc. agreed to acquire all U.S. nuclear fuel processing assets of Radnostix, Inc. and International Isotopes Fluorine Products, Inc., including NRC Material License SUB-1011, a New Mexico air permit, patents and Sequoyah Fuels documentation tied to a planned DUF6 deconversion plant in Lea County. Consideration is not disclosed beyond a $0.5 million Citibank escrow deposit. Closing is expected in roughly 90-120 days, subject to NRC license-transfer consent and New Mexico approvals; watch regulatory timing risk.
